details: ive been playing vrchat for 2 years now as a quest player since i dont have the money for a Pc and I have never had much issuses with avaters and now all of a sudden im hearing about how quest playes avatars will become useable including our uploaded avatars that we have payed for or worked hard to make. I dont really find it fair that Vrchat is starting to leave nothing for other players, its ridiculous that we have to spend thousands of dollers just to play the game and make friends and wear the avatars we want its feels like there trying to kick quest players out of the game completely including quest compatible worlds. its almost like quest players are being forced to sit in ugly gray avatars and weird looking fall backs and sit in a empty world and do nothing while PC and PCVR players get to enjoy the fun it does not seem fair. of you was going to release a game to quest at least make it as fair to all other players or just dont release the game on that platform at all. Please stop taking our avatars and worlds away from quest users unable to afford PCs it’s not fair
title: Quest Avatars and worlds
